'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Joe Orthner LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Orthner]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
